Which of the following best explains why the temperature of a substance remains constant during melting, even though thermal energy is being added?

  1. The added energy increases the average kinetic energy of the particles.
  2. The energy is used to increase the pressure of the substance.
  3. The energy is used to break intermolecular bonds, not to increase particle speed.
  4. The substance releases energy to its surroundings at the same rate it absorbs it.
